sara (PM): Heads-up - execs asked for a short runbook we can hand to sales for pilot SOWs: must include retention tiers, BYOK options, and SLA bullets. Need draft by EOD Wednesday.
aj (Eng): I'll sketch technical bullets. Question: do we promise ability to decrypt for customer if they hold keys? If keys never leave customer KMS, we can't decrypt.
mohit (Security): We need to be explicit: BYOK modes: 
- BYOK-Proxy: customer grants Redwood a limited decrypt token (timeboxed) for e-discovery.
- BYOK-CrossAccount: customer KMS allows Redwood a cross-account decrypt mechanism for export only.
- BYOK-NoExport: customer retains keys; Redwood stores ciphertext only (no export promise).
claire (Legal): Sales must use templated FAQ explaining legal responsibilities, especially for NoExport. Also define jurisdictional constraints for regional HSMs.
sara (PM): Draft runbook bullets: 
- Retention tiers: Bronze/Silver/Gold with respective metadata/payload windows.
- Export SLAs: Bronze none, Silver 72h, Gold 48h.
- BYOK options: Proxy/CrossAccount/NoExport with contract checklist.
- Evidence integrity: per-export manifest + SHA256 hash chain.
- Audit trail: KMS ops emitted to immutable control-plane stream.
- Special buckets: regulated customers may require HSM in-region and legal hold override.
ops-bot: Runbook doc created: https://docs.redwood/internal/pilot-sow-runbook (access: product,security,sales)
aj (Eng): Technical caveat to include: retrieving archived payloads may incur rehydration cost and time; state that 48/72h are contingent on retrieval path not being blocked.
mohit (Security): Recommend also including a timeline for key rotation and minimum overlap window to ensure decryptability for exports.
tim (Infra): I'll add an appendix on cost levers (index retention, archive class, pre-warm, retrieval throughput).
sara (PM): Perfect. Action items: tim + aj: appendix + rehydration note (due Tue). mohit + claire: BYOK checklist + legal Qs (due Tue). I'll package and hand to sales Wed AM.
aj (Eng): One more: log retention for telemetry vs evidence should be separated; evidence retention follows the tiers, telemetry follows org policy.
sara (PM): Noted. Closing. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
